biw_news.title: Robotic Dry Fiber Cell and 2,400-Ton Composite Press Cut Aerostructure Production Time by 90%
biw_news.summary: The COMPASS facility at the University of Sheffield's AMRC features a high-rate robotic dry fiber cell and a 2,400-ton composite press. This advanced manufacturing setup dramatically accelerates the production of complex, high-strength structural composite components.

biw_news.title: Novelis Expands Advanced Aluminum Portfolio for Structural Battery Enclosures
biw_news.summary: Novelis is expanding its footprint in the lightweight vehicle sector by introducing high-performance coated aluminum sheets optimized for structural battery packs. The new alloy portfolio aims to improve crash energy management and reduce overall body-in-white weight.

biw_news.title: OCSiAl Integrates Single-Wall Carbon Nanotubes into High-Energy Density Battery Cell Structures
biw_news.summary: By supplying TUBALL single-wall carbon nanotubes to the EU-backed ELEVATE project, OCsial is helping reinforce the internal mechanical and electrical integrity of high-energy battery cells. These advanced conductive additives are critical for maintaining structural stability under extreme specific energy thresholds exceeding 400 Wh/kg.

biw_news.title: Daher Implements Direct Stamping and Infrared Welding for Thick Thermoplastic Composite Structures
biw_news.summary: Daher's Highly Loaded Thermoplastic Wing Rib program validates novel Direct Stamping and infrared welding technologies for high-load-bearing applications. These advanced joining techniques establish a repeatable manufacturing baseline for lightweight, high-integrity structural components.

biw_news.title: Neuman Aluminium Enhances Scrap Recovery and Casthouse Efficiency via Austria Furnace Retrofit
biw_news.summary: Neuman Aluminium has successfully upgraded its melting furnace with an advanced electromagnetic stirring system at its Austrian headquarters. The retrofit significantly optimizes recycled metal recovery and alloy consistency for downstream automotive extrusions and sheet metal applications.

biw_news.title: BMW Integrates Neue Klasse EV Architecture Across Upcoming Entry-Level Hatchback Platforms
biw_news.summary: BMW has confirmed the application of its flexible Neue Klasse electric vehicle architecture to upcoming entry-level hatchbacks and compact crossovers. This dedicated skateboard chassis approach allows for optimized battery pack integration and improved structural rigidity.
